meta.access: read-only SELECT via the Supabase MCP execute_sql tool

material_change.definition: the series evidence differs materially between the legacy zero-filled window and the v1 common window: STRONG flips, OR availability differs, OR |delta correlation| >= 0.05, OR the ratio moves by >= 10 % (a reporting convention, not a policy value)

examples: jaecoo-jaecoo-j5 -> jaecoo.jaecoo_5_ev [CONTRADICTION: 'j5' vs '5 ev'; corr 1.000 ratio 0.998]
jaecoo-jaecoo-j6 -> jaecoo.jaecoo_6_ev [CONTRADICTION: 'j6' vs '6 ev'; corr 0.994 ratio 0.918]
volt-volt-volt -> volt.volt_for_four [CONTRADICTION: 'volt' vs 'for four'; corr 1.000 ratio 1.000]

boundaries.band: pairs with a usable series and ratio inside 0.9..1.1 whose correlation is within 0.97 .. < 0.99
pairs with correlation >= 0.98 whose ratio is within 0.85 .. < 0.95
pairs with correlation >= 0.98 whose ratio is within 1.05 .. < 1.15
pairs whose correlation and ratio pass and whose monthly fit share is within 0.65 .. < 0.85
STRONG pairs with 7 .. < 13 joint non-zero months
STRONG pairs whose smaller side has 60 .. < 240 units in the window
pairs with 4 .. < 9 common months (some are UNAVAILABLE because of this minimum)
pairs whose smaller side has 15 .. < 60 units in the window
STRONG pairs with 1 .. 24 unconfirmed-gap months in the window
name pairs that differ by exactly one one-edit token pair shorter than 6 letters (and >= 4)
usable pairs with correlation within 0.4 .. < 0.6 and a non-candidate name
usable pairs with ratio within 0.4 .. < 0.6 or 1.6 .. < 2.5 and a non-candidate name
SUBJECT_FINER pairs with a usable series and ratio within 1.0 .. < 1.4
pairs with a lifecycle share within 0.7 .. < 0.9
pairs with a lifecycle share within 0.1 .. < 0.3
groups whose two best proposable candidates differ by 0.005 .. < 0.02 in correlation or 0.02 .. < 0.1 in |ln ratio|
groups with >= 2 members eligible for a link set (enumeration runs when no single candidate is strong); examples show the eligible-pool sizes and the sizes of the sets chosen
examples: enumeration ran for 775 groups; eligible members per group: 0x694, 1x62, 2x16, 3x1, 5x2
groups whose eligible pool exceeded the cap of 12: 0
COMPOSED_OF decisions by number of members: 2 members x11, 3 members x1

no one-edit typo tolerance at all

rivals are tied when correlation differs by < 0.005 (was 0.01)
rivals are tied when correlation differs by < 0.03

no sum rule: several subjects are never grouped as parts

link sets of at most 2 members (was 3)
link sets of at most 4 members
